taxonomy_basis: AES-128 transaction and datapath obligations; drafted after saved results and therefore not blind

scenarios.name: reset and idle state
scenarios.spec_citation: AES top interface contract: reset establishes a deterministic idle state

scenarios.name: load and transaction start
scenarios.spec_citation: AES top interface contract: an idle ld request samples key/text and starts one operation

scenarios.name: busy input and load isolation
scenarios.spec_citation: AES transaction contract: an active operation has deterministic input and reload behavior

scenarios.name: completion and fixed latency
scenarios.spec_citation: AES top interface contract: each accepted transaction reaches done after the defined round sequence

scenarios.name: output validity and holding window
scenarios.spec_citation: AES top interface contract: text_out is sampled at completion and remains deterministic in its defined window

scenarios.name: back-to-back transactions
scenarios.spec_citation: AES transaction contract: adjacent accepted requests remain distinct transactions

scenarios.name: known-answer and random reference vectors
scenarios.spec_citation: FIPS 197 AES-128 encryption result and project known-answer interface examples

scenarios.name: byte mapping and pattern-sensitive inputs
scenarios.spec_citation: FIPS 197 state representation and project text/key port ordering

scenarios.name: round and key-schedule boundaries
scenarios.spec_citation: FIPS 197 AES-128 initial, middle, final-round and key-expansion sequence

line_coverage_targets.name: complete shared instrumented AES RTL scope
line_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Fraction of the 374 identically instrumented AES RTL lines hit at least once; local 7/7, 16/16 and 16/16 regions remain diagnostics

functional_coverage_targets.name: reset and idle contract
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Exercise reset assertion, release, and an idle observation window
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample control and output signals at reset, first released cycle, and stable idle
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: The public interface matches the frozen reset/idle contract
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: transaction acceptance
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Exercise an idle load that samples one key/text pair and starts encryption
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample ld, key, text_in, and the first active-cycle state
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: Exactly one transaction is accepted under the documented load rule
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: busy input isolation
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Toggle key/text and attempt load while an operation is active
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample the active transaction before and after each busy-cycle disturbance
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: Behavior matches the frozen busy/reload contract without corrupting the active operation
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: completion latency
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Observe accepted load through the specified completion cycle
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample done and cycle count on every active cycle
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: done assertion and latency match the frozen transaction contract
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: AES-128 known-answer encryption
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Exercise the frozen FIPS-197 known-answer vectors
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample ciphertext only in the contract-defined valid output window
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: text_out equals the corresponding AES-128 reference ciphertext
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: key and state byte mapping
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Exercise sparse and asymmetric vectors that distinguish byte-order mappings
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample the accepted input vector and final ciphertext for every mapping pattern
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: Ciphertext matches the FIPS-197 state and key byte ordering
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: output validity and hold window
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Observe text_out before, at, and after done
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample text_out across the complete frozen output-validity window
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: Output validity and stability match the interface contract
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: back-to-back transactions
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Exercise two adjacent accepted transactions with distinct key/text pairs
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample acceptance and ciphertext identity for both transactions
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: Each output belongs to its corresponding accepted transaction
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run

functional_coverage_targets.name: initial, middle, and final round boundaries
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Exercise a transaction across the initial AddRoundKey, middle rounds, and final round
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample common observable boundary indicators or approved reference checkpoints
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: Boundary ordering and final-round behavior match AES-128
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: shared functional collector not yet run
